'''Voromuzz''', also known as '''Voromuzz the Brooding''', was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] warlord who lived thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During [[Gender/Legends|his]] lifetime, he arranged for the construction of a palace for himself on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Varl/Legends|Varl]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
